headword: {数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}

definitions.explanation: An approximate amount in the range of roughly two to nine million yen (about US$15,000–60,000). Uses the prefix {数|すう} (several) to give a rough estimate rather than an exact figure.

examples.japanese: {修理費|しゅうりひ}は{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}かかった。
examples.english: The repair costs came to several million yen.

examples.japanese: {年収|ねんしゅう}{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}の{家庭|かてい}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many households have an annual income of several million yen.

examples.japanese: {詐欺|さぎ}{被害|ひがい}にあった{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}は、{老後|ろうご}の{蓄|たくわ}えから{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: The elderly fraud victim lost several million yen from their retirement savings.

notes:
Formed from {数|すう} (several) + {百万|ひゃくまん} (one million) + {円|えん} (yen). The prefix {数|すう} denotes a rough, unspecified count, typically between two and nine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}{単位|たんい}: in units of millions of yen
- {数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}の{損害|そんがい}: damages of several million yen
- {数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}の{借金|しゃっきん}: debt of several million yen
- {年収|ねんしゅう}{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}: an annual income of several million yen

RELATED WORDS:
- {数十万円|すうじゅうまんえん}: several hundred thousand yen
- {数千万円|すうせんまんえん}: tens of millions of yen
- {数億円|すうおくえん}: several hundred million yen
